increment: B5.5 (docs/phase_b4_plan.md, "The flips"): a frame's changed nets in one dispatch, keyed on their steps; B5.4's B2 gate taken again
gate: pixels against grids <= 0.5% over 24/255 on every Surface fixture and every measured frame that draws one; the browser-side complete frame within 5% of grids (--limit 1.05), per class and format
why_not_flipped: The gate passes on the three scenes it was set on, where surfaces are a small share of the frame. On scenes that are mostly surfaces the same recipe fails: the orbs fixture as a scene (70 spheres) on still and camera frames, 1.16-1.31x grids, and a 480-sphere lattice on still and camera frames, 1.37-1.52x, and on pixels, 0.98% over 24/255 (silhouettes, the same with B5.4's driver). The cost is the redraw, not the evaluation: a net draws its capacity's triangle pattern, a draw of its own, where grids coalesce. So the default stays grids; nets are the Phase B selection and MANIML_SURFACE=nets.

surface_dominated.recipe: the same six commands per scene as the gate (README.md, 'Runs'), MANIML_* unset
